name: Kazami Yuuka
source:
Yuuka is a long-lived youkai called the "Flower Master of the Four Seasons" whose main place of activity is the Garden of the Sun, a field completely covered in sunflowers. She loves seasonal flowers, so throughout the year she moves to the respective places where the flowers grow.

[From [url=https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Wriggle_Nightbug]Touhou Wiki[/url]]
